title: Pubnet Soroban call whose return value is an SCV_U256 above 2^128
why: An SCV_U256 is four 64-bit limbs; SEP-51 renders it as a decimal string. This return value needs all 255 bits, so a reader that narrows 256-bit integers to 128 bits, or to a float, loses it.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `S|site|meta.v4.sorobanMeta.returnValue:SCVal{SCV_U256}d=1n=1`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: About 2^254: the top limb is nonzero.
The call's event carries the same value as data.
